decisions.why: all 9 examples are named scissor types (Bonn Iris, Biemer Vein, Bergmann Bandage, Bellucci Micro, BeeBee Crown, Beckmann Nasal, Barraquer Iris, Aston SuperCut Facelift, Adventitia Micro) — scissors
all 6 examples are named needle holders (Collier, Castroviejo Micro, Bozeman, Barraquer-Troutman Micro, Barraquer Micro, Arruga Micro) — needle holders & suture passers
single product, Iris Scissor — same item type already mapped under this supplier's own Surgical Scissors division

the division's own 7 examples are individual loose instruments, not procedure kits: Iris Scissor and Operating Scissors are scissors, Scalpel Handle No 7/No 4/Bard Parker No 3 are scalpel handles, and Yankauer Suction Tube is a suction tube — three distinct instrument types genuinely present, not a guess
